name: Pyromancer Flames of Focus raises the Flamecasting stack cap (#2221)
contract: Flames of Focus 680977 reads "Adds $s1 additional stack to Flamecasting and increases its duration by $/1000;s2 sec." Effect 0 is aura 107 SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS BasePoints 0 (+1) and effect 1 SPELLMOD_DURATION BasePoints 4999 (+5000 ms), both on class mask 0x2000 (Flamecasting 804301, StackAmount 5, duration 15000 ms), so Flamecasting stacks to 6 and lasts 20 s. The duration half already worked; the stack half was lost because AscensionPyromancer::Flames capped the count at the literal 5 through Aura::SetStackAmount.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Emberheart grants its five Flamecasting stacks
Flamecasting reaches 6 stacks with Flames of Focus (5 + 1)
Flamecasting lasts longer than its native 15000 ms
